documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY26, driven by expanded owned fleet capabilities, disciplined execution, and cost management, with consolidated total income growing by 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores. The company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis and plans further fleet expansion alongside strategic participation in offshore and maritime growth opportunities. Looking ahead, management expects approximately 10% top-line growth in FY27 assuming vessels run in the second half, while maintaining EBITDA margins in the 45% to 50% band. Operations will continue to focus on disciplined fleet expansion, prudent capital allocation, and operational efficiency. ABS Marine Services Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the half year and year ended 31st March 2026, highlighting growth in consolidated total income to ₹322.64 crore and net profit to ₹80.80 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line growth of approximately 10% for the current financial year FY27, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the EBITDA margin band of 45% to 50% will continue for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

guidance.claim: Management expects the tax rate for FY27 to be around a maximum of 1.5% to 2%.
guidance.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about opportunities in the offshore and maritime sectors driven by initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and increased investments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the opportunities emerging within the offshore and maritime sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market supported by an aging global fleet and limited new additions continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that ONGC is anticipated to release a tender for about 20 vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

demand_outlook.claim: It was noted that offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company scheduled delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The total cost of acquisition for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV, was about $15 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received delivery of the offshore vessel AM Passion.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis for FY26, EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, with EBITDA margin expanding by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: For H2 FY26, consolidated total income stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns a total of 12 vessels, which includes four smaller vessels on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter.

orders_capacity.claim: Top 10 clients contribute around 90% of revenue.
The company secured an offshore charter contract from Larsen & Toubro Limited for a DP2 Platform Supply Vessel.
The company bagged a port services project at Deendayal Port for deploying qualified fire service personnel.

capital_allocation.claim: Management emphasizes prudent capital allocation as part of its ongoing strategy to support sustainable long-term growth.
capital_allocation.quote: Going forward, our strategy remains focused on disciplined fleet expansion, prudent capital allocation, operational excellence, and enhancing our offshore capabilities to support sustainable long-term growth.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that bankers are comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio and funding is not viewed as a problem.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that currency exchange rate movement plays a role in the cost of vessel acquisition.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical situations like the Iran war have caused problems regarding fuel prices and government programs.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you know that Iran war has really caused a huge kind of problem for our government.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
